hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: A custom AMM hook implementing Pendle-style yield trading for Principal Tokens (PTs) on Uniswap V4. Uses a custom curve with beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fully handle swap execution, disables swaps after PT maturity via block.timestamp expiry, and optionally rehypothecates idle liquidity into ERC4626 vaults to boost LP yields.
